title: Credits ledger
prompt: Every new account starts with 100 free credits. Write creditBalance(events). events is a list processed in order, each { type, amount } with a positive whole number amount. buy and refund add credits. use subtracts credits, but only if the balance covers it; otherwise the use is rejected and the balance does not change. Return { balance, rejected } where rejected is how many uses were rejected.

title: Read a query string
prompt: Write parseQuery(qs) that turns a URL query string into an object. A leading ? is ignored. Split pairs on & and split each pair on the first =. Decode percent-escapes, and treat + as a space. A key with no = gets the value "". A key that appears more than once becomes an array of values in order; a key that appears once stays a string. Skip empty pieces such as a=1&&b=2.

title: Fix the pagination bug
prompt: The function below should return one page of a list. Pages start at 1. It returns { items, page, totalPages, hasNext }. A page below 1 is treated as page 1. A page beyond the last page returns an empty items list and keeps the page number given. An empty list has totalPages 0 and hasNext false. hasNext is true when a later page exists. It has bugs. Find them, fix them, and be ready to explain what was wrong.

title: Indian mobile number check
prompt: Write isValidIndianMobile(input) that returns true or false. A valid number is 10 digits and starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9. It may have one prefix: +91, 91 or 0. Spaces and dashes anywhere are ignored. Any other character, or any other length, is invalid. A value that is not a string is invalid.
